extension-library.description: Scaffold a customer Layer 2 extension library that contributes slots, rules, actions and components to the Satori platform.

extension-rule.description: Add a named rule evaluator to an existing extension library. A rule gates whether a surface is offered — it is not authorisation.

extension-action.description: Add an action handler to an existing extension library. Where it appears is Layer 1 configuration; what it does is the handler.

extension-component.description: Scaffold a standalone component in an existing extension library and register it by ID behind a lazy import.

satori-component.description: Add an nxs- component to the platform's own component library, registered by ID for a slot, with its spec, story, Overview page, export, reference row and with-and-without-Satori section. Internal: customers contribute with extension-component under their own prefix.

config-package.description: Scaffold a Nuxeo Marketplace package that configures Satori (Layer 0 and Layer 1 fragments), with a build target that checks the fragments and writes the installable zip.

app-package.description: Scaffold a business app: an app definition package, version 2, with app.json, labels/en.json, the component that contributes its layouts, and version 1's package files. With --type and the content model it writes the first record page too; without one, the pipeline refuses the package until a layout is added, as it refuses every package that contributes nothing. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-layout.description: Write a version 2 view layout, a document type's record page, from the type's schemas in the server's content model (a file, or read live), and have the package's component contribute it. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-form.description: Write a version 2 form, a document type's Edit or Create form, from the type's schemas in the server's content model (a file, or read live), with the fields --required names required, and have the package's component contribute it as app-layout does a record page. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-queue.description: Write a queue for a business app: a page provider's records, with columns, a sort and a page size. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-action.description: Add an action to a business app: a lifecycle transition or an allowed Automation operation, on the record page or a queue. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-registry.description: Have a business app's component contribute the app to the app registry: the <app> element, from agentic-ui-config/app.json, naming every file of the app definition the registry serves. Writes it when there is none, and otherwise brings its files in step with the package's. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.

app-model.description: For a demo only: write a stand-in model into a business app package, a document type with its schema, and page providers over it, in a model component of its own that the manifest lists, with a content-model.json the other generators and the pipeline can be given. A customer's model is Studio's, already on their server. Internal: it writes a package this repository's pipeline checks and builds (scripts/app-package.mjs), naming this repository's JSON Schemas, so it is not shipped in @nuxeo/satori-platform.
